verdict.rationale: Base44's Superagent docs say directly that a workflow can run on a schedule or when a trigger fires, such as activity in a connected tool. Agents can also trigger workflows from chat. That covers the core of scheduling recurring workflows, but the evidence is a single short doc line. Missing for 10: details on recurrence options (cron expressions, intervals, time zones), scheduled jobs for app backends outside Superagents, run history and monitoring, and independent or hands-on confirmation that scheduling works.
